explication: OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop is a microservice-based demo storefront built to illustrate distributed-system observability. A shopper uses the web storefront to browse products, manage a cart, and place an order; checkout coordinates cart retrieval, shipping quotes, payment, and confirmation. Distinct services provide catalog, currency, ads, recommendations, shipping, and other shop capabilities. The graph emphasizes those product stages and the observable service runtime. Several services are represented from the README and tree only; dashed, uncited links mark relationships not verified in the sampled source.
